title.value: Postdoctoral Fellowships at Massachusetts Institute of Technology
title.evidence_quote: Postdoctoral Fellowships at Massachusetts Institute of Technology

field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)
qualifications: PhD within 5 years of the fellowship start date (PhD students may apply if graduating before the start)
Danish host institution employing the fellow for the whole grant period
description_short: Novo Nordisk Foundation postdoctoral fellowship: two years at MIT, then a final return year at a Danish host institution. Interdisciplinary projects in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology with potential impact on human health or sustainability. Earliest start 1 October 2027.

compensation.value: Up to approximately DKK 1.2 million per year, maximum DKK 3.6 million per fellowship
